tagline.zh: 從黑便交班到最後一支內視鏡
tagline.en: From a melaena handover to the last scope of the day

desc.zh: 跟著師傅查房、評估出血、接電話、寫交班。
desc.en: Round with the mentor, assess the bleeder, take the calls, write the handover.

desc.zh: 開室準備、鎮靜監測、器械與檢體，是內視鏡室真正的主人。
desc.en: Room set-up, sedation monitoring, instruments and specimens: the person who actually runs the suite.

about.zh: 消化內科主治，問題永遠比答案多。桌上那杯咖啡從早上放到下午，沒有人看過他喝。
about.en: Gastroenterologist with more questions than answers. The coffee on his desk sits from morning to afternoon; nobody has ever seen him drink it.

about.zh: 在內視鏡室十二年，閉著眼睛也能接好光源。口頭禪：「鏡子不會自己乾淨。」
about.en: Twelve years in the suite; can connect a light source blindfolded. Catchphrase: 'Scopes do not clean themselves.'

about.zh: 值了一整夜，手上拿著三張交班單和一個麵包。講話很快，但重點都在。
about.en: Up all night, holding three handover sheets and a bun. Talks fast, but every point lands.

about.zh: 64 歲退休公車司機，膝蓋痛了十年，止痛藥自己買。這兩天大便變黑，站起來會暈。最想回家看孫子。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 64-year-old retired bus driver with ten years of knee pain and self-bought painkillers. Black stools for two days, dizzy when he stands. Mostly wants to go home to his grandson. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 帶了一袋自己包的粽子來，堅信吃飽才會好。
about.en: Arrives with a bag of home-made rice dumplings, convinced that eating well cures everything.

about.zh: 28 歲，潰瘍性結腸炎三年，平常控制得不錯。這週血便變多，上週才因為喉嚨痛吃過抗生素。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 28-year-old with ulcerative colitis for three years, usually well controlled. More bloody stools this week; took antibiotics for a sore throat last week. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 病房的千里眼，打電話永遠用 ISBAR，講完會問一句「你聽懂了嗎」。
about.en: The ward's early-warning system. Always calls in ISBAR and ends with 'did you get all that?'

plain.zh: 大便又黑又黏像柏油，通常表示上消化道（胃或十二指腸）在出血。
plain.en: Black, sticky, tar-like stool, usually a sign of bleeding high in the gut (stomach or duodenum).

plain.zh: 站起來就頭暈，常代表身體裡的血量不夠，是出血量的早期警訊。
plain.en: Feeling faint on standing. It often means the circulation is short of blood: an early warning of how much has been lost.

plain.zh: 紅血球裡載氧的蛋白。急性出血剛開始時數值可能還正常，所以不能只看它。
plain.en: The oxygen-carrying protein in red cells. Early in an acute bleed the number can still look normal, so it is never read alone.

plain.zh: 用一條有鏡頭的軟管從嘴巴進去看食道、胃和十二指腸，必要時直接止血。
plain.en: A flexible camera passed through the mouth to look at the oesophagus, stomach and duodenum, and to stop bleeding on the spot.

plain.zh: 暫時不吃不喝，讓胃是空的，鏡檢才看得清楚、鎮靜也比較安全。
plain.en: Nothing to eat or drink for a while, so the stomach is empty: a clearer view and safer sedation.

plain.zh: 這裡指非類固醇消炎止痛藥，長期吃會傷胃黏膜，是潰瘍出血常見的原因。
plain.en: Here, anti-inflammatory painkillers. Taken long term they damage the stomach lining and are a common cause of bleeding ulcers.

plain.zh: 止血之後又流血。警訊包括再次黑便、心跳變快、血壓下降、頭暈加重。
plain.en: Bleeding again after it has been controlled. Warning signs: more black stool, a faster pulse, a falling blood pressure, worse dizziness.

plain.zh: 電話交班的順序：自我介紹、情境、背景、評估、建議。讓對方三十秒內知道該做什麼。
plain.en: The order for a clinical phone call: Identify, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. The listener knows what to do within thirty seconds.

plain.zh: 胰臟分泌的酵素，血中升高支持胰臟炎，但數值高低不代表病有多嚴重。
plain.en: An enzyme from the pancreas. A raised blood level supports pancreatitis, but how high it is does not say how sick the patient is.

plain.zh: 膽囊裡的石頭，掉進膽管會堵住胰液出口，是胰臟炎最常見的原因之一。
plain.en: Stones in the gallbladder. One that slips into the bile duct can block the pancreatic outflow, a leading cause of pancreatitis.

plain.zh: 大腸黏膜長期發炎的免疫疾病，會反覆發作，發作時血便增多。
plain.en: An immune condition where the lining of the large bowel stays inflamed. It flares from time to time, with more bloody stools.

plain.zh: 肝臟排不掉的毒素影響大腦，人會變得嗜睡、日夜顛倒、反應慢。常有誘因，像便祕、感染、新的安眠藥。
plain.en: Toxins the failing liver cannot clear affect the brain: drowsiness, day-night reversal, slowed thinking. Usually triggered by constipation, infection or a new sedative.

plain.zh: 鏡檢時夾下來的一小塊組織，裝進有病人標籤的罐子送病理科化驗。
plain.en: A tiny piece of tissue taken during the scope, placed in a labelled pot and sent to pathology.

plain.zh: 裝著急救藥物、氧氣面罩和電擊器的推車。鎮靜前一定要知道它在哪。
plain.en: The trolley with emergency drugs, oxygen masks and the defibrillator. Before any sedation you must know where it is.

text.zh: 光源、影像處理器、螢幕、送氣送水與吸引都疊在同一台推車上。開室前要測試每一項，白平衡沒校正，黏膜顏色就不可信。
text.en: Light source, video processor, screen, insufflation, water and suction stacked on one trolley. Every function is tested before the first case; without a white balance the colour of the lining cannot be trusted.

text.zh: 心跳、血壓、血氧、呼吸。鎮靜時最重要的是血氧和呼吸型態，數字會比病人的臉先告訴你出事了。
text.en: Pulse, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, breathing. Under sedation the saturation and the breathing pattern matter most; the numbers change before the face does.

text.zh: 消化內科的聽診器延伸。看膽囊有沒有結石、膽管有沒有擴張、腹水有多少，不用把病人推去放射科。
text.en: The gastroenterologist's extended stethoscope. Gallstones, a dilated bile duct, how much ascites: answered at the bedside without a trip to radiology.

text.zh: 紅色、上鎖、每班點檢。放在固定位置，所以每個人都找得到。鎮靜前先確認位置是內視鏡室的規矩。
text.en: Red, sealed, checked every shift, always in the same place so anyone can find it. Confirming where it is before sedation is a house rule of the suite.

text.zh: 十二指腸潰瘍邊緣與胃竇各取的切片，泡在固定液裡，罐身貼著吳先生的雙識別標籤。沒有標籤的檢體等於沒有檢體。
text.en: Biopsies from the ulcer edge and the stomach antrum in fixative, the pot carrying Mr Wu's two identifiers. An unlabelled specimen is no specimen at all.

text.zh: 醫院所有影像都在這裡。先核對病人姓名與檢查日期，再看片；看片前先問自己「我想回答什麼問題」。
text.en: Every image in the hospital lives here. Check the name and the study date first, then look; and before looking, ask what question the image is meant to answer.

text.zh: 自我介紹、情境、背景、評估、建議。病房打來的每一通電話、下班前的每一次交班都用同一個骨架，聽的人才不會漏。
text.en: Identify, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Every ward call and every end-of-shift handover uses the same skeleton so nothing falls through.

text.zh: 止血不是結束。再次黑便或吐血、心跳變快、血壓下降、頭暈加重、尿變少，任何一項都要重新評估，不是等明天抽血。
text.en: Haemostasis is not the end. Fresh black stool or vomited blood, a faster pulse, a falling pressure, worse dizziness, less urine: any one means reassess now, not at tomorrow's blood test.

guide.en: Hear the night handover

lines.zh: 7 床吳先生，64 歲，黑便兩天，站起來會暈。今天早上血紅素還可以。
lines.en: Bed 7, Mr Wu, 64. Black stools for two days, dizzy on standing. Haemoglobin this morning still acceptable.

lines.zh: 膝蓋痛，止痛藥自己在藥局買，吃了十年。12 床肝硬化的昨晚很安靜。
lines.en: Knee pain, painkillers bought over the counter for ten years. Bed 12 with cirrhosis was quiet overnight.

lines.zh: 血紅素還可以，那是不是可以先不緊張？
lines.en: If the haemoglobin is fine, can we relax a little?

lines.zh: 這句話你等一下自己去問陳主治。我去睡了。
lines.en: Ask Dr Chen that one yourself. I am going to sleep.

guide.en: Find Dr Chen

lines.zh: 早。咖啡？不用，我有。說說 7 床，你覺得他出了多少血？
lines.en: Morning. Coffee? No, I have one. Tell me about bed 7. How much blood do you think he has lost?

lines.zh: 血紅素還可以，所以……不多？
lines.en: The haemoglobin is acceptable, so... not much?

lines.zh: 剛流出去的血，血紅素要幾個小時才會跟著掉。先看循環，再看數字。
lines.en: Haemoglobin lags hours behind a fresh bleed. Read the circulation first, the number second.

post.zh: 很好。心跳快、姿勢性頭暈、皮膚蒼白，這三件事比一次抽血誠實。
post.en: Good. A fast pulse, postural dizziness and pallor are more honest than one blood test.

guide.zh: 到護理站處理早上的醫囑
guide.en: Sort the morning orders at the station

lines.zh: 護理站的螢幕上是吳先生的病歷。早餐車已經在走廊上響了，護理師在等醫囑。
lines.en: Mr Wu's chart is open at the station. The breakfast trolley is already rattling down the corridor and the nurse is waiting for orders.

q.zh: 吳先生今天早上的第一件事是？
q.en: What is the first thing for Mr Wu this morning?

options.zh: 禁食、兩條靜脈、通知內視鏡室
options.en: Nil by mouth, two lines, tell endoscopy

why.zh: 胃要是空的，鏡檢才看得到出血點；靜脈通路先建好，變化時才來得及。
why.en: An empty stomach lets the scope see the bleeding point; lines placed now are lines ready when he deteriorates.

options.zh: 讓他先吃早餐，吃飽再檢查

why.zh: 吃了早餐，鏡檢就得延後，視野也差；鎮靜時嗆到的風險更高。
why.en: Breakfast means a delayed scope, a poor view and a higher risk of aspiration under sedation.

options.zh: 等下午再抽一次血再決定
options.en: Repeat the blood test this afternoon

why.zh: 等待不會讓潰瘍停止流血。單次檢驗不能取代急性病程評估。
why.en: Waiting does not stop an ulcer bleeding. One result cannot replace assessing an acute course.

guide.en: Open the room: check the tower

lines.zh: 新來的？先跟我開室。鏡子不會自己乾淨，塔也不會自己亮。
lines.en: New here? Open the room with me first. Scopes do not clean themselves and towers do not switch themselves on.

lines.zh: 從哪裡開始？
lines.en: Where do we start?

q.zh: 把開室的步驟排成正確順序
q.en: Put the room-opening steps in order

steps.zh: 核對鏡子的洗消紀錄與效期
接上光源與影像處理器
備好止血器械與檢體罐
steps.en: Lay out haemostasis kit and pots

post.zh: 對。洗消紀錄永遠第一個看，沒有紀錄的鏡子不准進病人嘴巴。
post.en: Right. The reprocessing record always comes first. No record, no scope goes in a patient's mouth.

note.en: Assessed Mr Wu at the bedside

guide.en: See Mr Wu at bed 7

lines.zh: 醫師，我開了三十年公車都沒暈過，這兩天站起來天花板會轉。
lines.en: Doctor, thirty years driving buses and I never got dizzy. These two days the ceiling spins when I stand.

lines.zh: 膝蓋的止痛藥，一天吃幾次？
lines.en: The knee painkillers, how often do you take them?

lines.zh: 痛就吃啊。藥局的小姐說很溫和。
lines.en: Whenever it hurts. The pharmacy girl said they are gentle.

lines.zh: 「很溫和」的止痛藥吃十年，胃黏膜不會同意。先摸肚子，壓痛會改變你的想法。
lines.en: Ten years of 'gentle' painkillers; the stomach lining disagrees. Examine the abdomen first. Tenderness changes your thinking.

post.zh: 軟、不脹、上腹輕壓痛。沒有腹膜炎的樣子。這很重要，因為等一下要鎮靜。
post.en: Soft, not distended, mild epigastric tenderness. No peritonitis. That matters, because he will be sedated shortly.

guide.en: Talk to Mrs Wu

lines.zh: 醫師，我包了粽子，他昨天都沒吃。吃飽才有力氣啊。
lines.en: Doctor, I made rice dumplings. He barely ate yesterday. You need food to get strong.

lines.zh: 吳太太，今天要做上消化道內視鏡，他現在要禁食。粽子先冰起來好嗎？
lines.en: Mrs Wu, he is having an upper endoscopy today, so he must stay nil by mouth. Could the dumplings go in the fridge for now?

lines.zh: ……那做完可以吃嗎？
lines.en: ...Can he eat them afterwards?

lines.zh: 做完我們再一起決定。您願意等，他比較安全。
lines.en: We decide together once it is done. Your waiting keeps him safer.

lines.zh: 吳太太把粽子抱回懷裡，像抱著一個被沒收的禮物。
lines.en: Mrs Wu hugs the dumplings to her chest like a confiscated present.

guide.en: Watch the monitor as he stands

lines.zh: 吳先生堅持自己下床上廁所。他站起來的那一刻，監視器開始響。
lines.en: Mr Wu insists on walking to the toilet himself. The moment he stands, the monitor starts to alarm.

options.zh: 扶他平躺、抬腳、叫師傅、依醫囑備血
options.en: Lie him flat, legs up, call the mentor, blood per protocol

why.zh: 先把血送回腦和心臟，再升級。這是出血影響循環的證據，不是暈眩而已。
why.en: Return blood to brain and heart first, then escalate. This is the bleed affecting the circulation, not simple dizziness.

options.en: Sit him down with warm water

why.zh: 他正在禁食，而且低血壓不是喝水能解決的事。
why.en: He is nil by mouth, and this hypotension will not be fixed by a glass of water.

options.zh: 扶他慢慢走去廁所再回來量
options.en: Walk him slowly to the toilet, re-check later

why.zh: 走過去的路上倒下，就多一個頭部外傷。
why.en: If he collapses on the way you have added a head injury.

post.zh: 看到了嗎？這就是「血紅素還可以」的病人。循環先說話。
post.en: See? That is your 'haemoglobin still acceptable' patient. The circulation speaks first.

post.zh: ……我躺著就好。孫子的事等一下再說。
post.en: ...I will stay lying down. The grandson can wait.

note.zh: 吳先生完成內視鏡止血

guide.en: Check in with Nurse Ko

lines.zh: 7 床早上喝了半碗稀飯。我把他排到最後，視野會差，鎮靜也要更小心。
lines.en: Bed 7 had half a bowl of congee this morning. I have moved him to the end of the list; the view will be poor and sedation needs more care.

lines.zh: 是我沒有開禁食……
lines.en: I did not write him nil by mouth...

lines.zh: 那就記住這碗稀飯。今天不會害到他，下次可能會。
lines.en: Then remember that bowl of congee. It will not hurt him today; next time it might.

guide.en: Check in with Nurse Ko

lines.zh: 7 床禁食到位，兩條靜脈都通，監視器接好了。第一台就是他。
lines.en: Bed 7 is nil by mouth, both lines running, monitor on. He is first on the list.

lines.zh: 謝謝。他太太的粽子在冰箱。
lines.en: Thanks. His wife's dumplings are in the fridge.

lines.zh: 我知道，她問了三次。
lines.en: I know. She asked three times.

guide.zh: 到內視鏡塔前做檢查前核對
guide.en: Pre-procedure check at the tower

lines.zh: 停一下。病人、檢查項目、過敏、抗凝血藥、鎮靜同意書。每個人都看著手環。
lines.en: Pause. Patient, procedure, allergies, blood thinners, sedation consent. Everyone looks at the wristband.

lines.zh: 吳先生，兩個識別符合。無過敏。沒有抗凝血藥。同意書簽了。
lines.en: Mr Wu, two identifiers match. No allergies. No anticoagulants. Consent signed.

lines.zh: 他剛剛在床邊血壓掉過。鏡檢之前，你還想確認什麼？
lines.en: His pressure dropped at the bedside earlier. Before we scope, what else do you want settled?

lines.zh: 他現在躺平血壓穩了，靜脈都通。我要確定他穩，鏡檢才是治療不是賭博。
lines.en: Lying flat his pressure is stable and both lines run. I want him stable first, so the scope is a treatment, not a gamble.

lines.zh: 對。那就開始。
lines.en: Right. Then we begin.

guide.en: Before sedation: where is the crash cart?

lines.zh: 鎮靜前的規矩。不要用講的，用走的，指給我看。
lines.en: House rule before sedation. Do not tell me, walk over and show me.

q.en: Find the crash cart in the room

post.zh: 好。希望今天用不到，但要知道它在那裡。
post.en: Good. We hope not to need it today, but we know where it is.

guide.en: Watch the screen: the scope goes in

lines.zh: 食道乾淨。胃裡有一點陳舊血。十二指腸球部：一個潰瘍，底部有一條會跳的血管。
lines.en: Clean oesophagus. A little old blood in the stomach. Duodenal bulb: an ulcer with a visible, pulsating vessel at its base.

lines.zh: 就是它。止血依流程做。柯護理師，器械。
lines.en: There it is. Haemostasis per protocol. Nurse Ko, the kit.

lines.zh: 來了。切片鉗在旁邊，等你止完血再取。
lines.en: Here. Biopsy forceps are beside it, for after you have stopped the bleeding.

lines.zh: 潰瘍邊緣和胃竇各取一塊。檢體罐標籤你核對，我不看螢幕以外的東西。
lines.en: One piece from the ulcer edge and one from the antrum. You check the pot labels; I am not looking away from the screen.

post.zh: 病理檢體兩罐，吳先生，雙識別，都對。
post.en: Two biopsy specimen pots, Mr Wu, two identifiers each, all correct.

guide.en: Take the call, then report to the mentor

sub.zh: 12 床肝硬化病人今天一直睡
sub.en: Bed 12 with cirrhosis has slept all day

lines.zh: 我是病房阿芳。12 床，61 歲肝硬化，今天叫不太醒，問話答非所問，昨晚還好好的。
lines.en: Fang from the ward. Bed 12, 61, cirrhosis, hard to rouse today and answering nonsense. He was fine last night.

lines.zh: 背景：家屬說他三天沒大便，前天開始吃兒子帶來的助眠藥。評估：體溫正常，肚子有點大。
lines.en: Background: family say no bowel motion for three days and he started a sleeping pill his son brought two days ago. Assessment: afebrile, abdomen a bit distended.

lines.zh: 聽起來像肝性腦病，而且誘因不只一個。我十分鐘到。請先別再給助眠藥。
lines.en: That sounds like hepatic encephalopathy with more than one trigger. I will be there in ten minutes. Please hold the sleeping pill for now.

lines.zh: 收到。你聽懂了嗎？
lines.en: Got it. Did you get all that?

lines.zh: 12 床意識變差，便祕三天加新的助眠藥。我想先處理誘因。
lines.en: Bed 12 is more confused: three days constipated plus a new sedative. I want to address the triggers first.

lines.zh: 好。還有一個你沒講的。腹水的病人變混亂，你還要排除什麼？
lines.en: Good. One thing you have not said. A patient with ascites becomes confused; what else must you exclude?

lines.zh: 感染。腹水感染、肺炎、尿路。還有出血。
lines.en: Infection. Infected ascites, pneumonia, urine. And bleeding.

lines.zh: 對。既有的肝病不能拿來解釋每一件新事。去吧，把腹水也抽了送檢。
lines.en: Right. Old liver disease does not get to explain every new thing. Go on, and send the ascites for analysis too.

note.en: Saw the ER upper abdominal pain

guide.zh: 推超音波車到床邊找膽囊
guide.en: Wheel the ultrasound over: find the gallbladder

lines.zh: 午餐？等一下。急診那位，脂肪酶很高，你的診斷是？
lines.en: Lunch? Later. The ER patient with the high lipase. Your diagnosis?

lines.zh: 胰臟炎。痛到背、嘔吐、脂肪酶都符合。
lines.en: Pancreatitis. Pain through to the back, vomiting, lipase: it all fits.

lines.zh: 診斷我同意。但診斷跟嚴重度是兩個問題。還有第三個：為什麼？她有膽結石嗎？
lines.en: I agree with the diagnosis. But diagnosis and severity are two different questions. And a third: why? Does she have gallstones?

lines.zh: 超音波車是我們的延伸聽診器。右上腹，找膽囊，看有沒有石頭和膽管擴張。
lines.en: The ultrasound cart is our extended stethoscope. Right upper quadrant, find the gallbladder, look for stones and a dilated duct.

post.zh: 膽囊裡好幾顆小石頭。病因浮出來了。那嚴重度呢？看她的尿量和呼吸。
post.en: Several small stones in the gallbladder. There is your cause. And severity? Look at her urine output and her breathing.

sub.zh: 49 歲女性上腹痛到背，脂肪酶升高
sub.en: 49-year-old woman, epigastric pain to the back, raised lipase

guide.zh: 到 PACS 看她的腹部影像
guide.en: Review her abdominal imaging on PACS

lines.zh: 急診做了影像。先核對名字和日期，再問自己：這張片要回答什麼問題？
lines.en: The ER did imaging. Check the name and date first, then ask: what question is this study meant to answer?

question.zh: 上腹痛加脂肪酶升高，影像要幫你回答什麼？
question.en: Epigastric pain with a raised lipase: what should the image answer for you?

answer.zh: 膽管有沒有擴張或結石、胰臟周圍有沒有發炎積液。它幫你找病因和併發症，不是用來「確診」胰臟炎。
answer.en: Whether the bile duct is dilated or holds a stone, and whether there is inflammatory fluid around the pancreas. It finds cause and complications; it is not how pancreatitis is 'confirmed'.

post.zh: 記住：脂肪酶告訴你「是」，影像和尿量告訴你「多嚴重、為什麼」。
post.en: Remember: lipase tells you 'yes'; imaging and urine output tell you 'how bad' and 'why'.

guide.en: Call Ms Lin into the room

lines.zh: 醫師，我的潰瘍性結腸炎又發作了。這次血比較多，一天跑七八次廁所。
lines.en: Doctor, my ulcerative colitis is flaring again. More blood this time, seven or eight trips to the toilet a day.

lines.zh: 有發燒嗎？最近有吃什麼新的藥？
lines.en: Any fever? Any new medicines recently?

lines.zh: 上週喉嚨痛，診所開了抗生素。昨天晚上有點熱熱的。
lines.en: A sore throat last week; the clinic gave me antibiotics. I felt a bit hot last night.

lines.zh: 聽到了嗎？抗生素加發燒加血便。這是一個「簡單的復發」嗎？
lines.en: Did you hear that? Antibiotics plus fever plus bloody stools. Is this a 'simple flare'?

q.zh: 除了復發，你今天還要做什麼？
q.en: Besides treating a flare, what else do you do today?

options.zh: 送糞便感染檢驗，發燒當感染查
options.en: Send stool infection tests; treat the fever as infection until proven otherwise

why.zh: 既有診斷不能取代新一輪評估。抗生素之後的血便，感染要先排除。
why.en: An old diagnosis does not replace a fresh assessment. Bloody stools after antibiotics: infection must be excluded first.

options.zh: 直接照上次的復發處方

why.zh: 如果這次是感染，加重免疫抑制會讓她更糟。
why.en: If this is an infection, stepping up immunosuppression makes her worse.

options.zh: 請她多喝水，兩週後回診
options.en: Fluids and review in two weeks

why.zh: 發燒加血便增多，兩週太久。
why.en: Fever with increasing bloody stools: two weeks is far too long.

post.zh: 她今天先留觀。我不喜歡那個「有點熱熱的」。
post.en: She stays for observation today. I do not like that 'a bit hot'.

guide.zh: 寫門診紀錄與留觀醫囑
guide.en: Write the clinic note and observation orders

lines.zh: 你寫下：排便次數、血量、發燒、抗生素時間線、腹部檢查。每一項都是等一下交班的骨架。
lines.en: You write: stool frequency, blood, fever, the antibiotic timeline, the abdominal exam. Each line is a rib of the handover to come.

lines.zh: 寫「血便增多」沒有用，寫幾次、多少血、從哪一天。數字會跟著病人走。
lines.en: 'More bloody stools' is useless. How many, how much, since which day. Numbers travel with the patient.

guide.en: Check on Mr Wu in recovery

lines.zh: 護理師……我睡了多久？肚子不痛了。粽子……
lines.en: Nurse... how long was I asleep? My stomach does not hurt. The dumplings...

lines.zh: 醒了就好。先喝一口水試試，粽子明天跟醫師談。再出血的警訊你太太也要聽一遍。
lines.en: Good, you are awake. A sip of water first; dumplings are a conversation for tomorrow. Your wife also needs to hear the rebleeding warning signs.

lines.zh: 我有在聽。黑便、心跳快、頭暈，馬上按鈴。
lines.en: I am listening. Black stool, fast heartbeat, dizziness: ring the bell at once.

guide.en: Take the call, go to the observation bed

sub.zh: 林小姐心跳很快，肚子脹起來
sub.en: Ms Lin is tachycardic and her abdomen is distending

lines.zh: 阿芳。留觀床林小姐，心跳一直快，肚子脹、不太想喝水，剛剛發燒了。你要來看。
lines.en: Fang. Ms Lin in observation: persistently fast heart rate, distended abdomen, not drinking, and she has just spiked a fever. You need to see her.

lines.zh: 你跑到床邊。監視器的心跳數字在跳，林小姐臉色不好，肚子鼓起來。
lines.en: You run to the bedside. The heart-rate number is climbing, Ms Lin looks grey, her abdomen is tense.

options.zh: 床邊評估、腹部檢查、叫師傅與外科、禁食、依醫囑影像
options.en: Assess, examine the abdomen, call mentor and surgeons, nil by mouth, imaging per orders

why.zh: 心跳快、腹脹、發燒的結腸炎病人可能是毒性結腸擴張，重症風險不只看排便次數。
why.en: A tachycardic, distended, febrile colitis patient may have toxic dilatation. Severity is not judged by stool count alone.

options.zh: 給退燒藥，明天門診再看
options.en: Antipyretic and review in clinic tomorrow

why.zh: 退燒藥會把警訊蓋掉，病不會停。
why.en: The antipyretic hides the warning sign; the disease does not stop.

options.zh: 請她多喝水，再觀察一小時

why.zh: 腹脹到不想喝水的腸子，不該再從嘴巴灌。
why.en: A bowel too distended to drink should not be filled from above.

guide.en: Escalate to the mentor

lines.zh: 還好你下午就送了糞便檢驗，感染那條線已經在跑。現在這是全身惡化，不是門診問題了。
lines.en: Good thing you sent the stool tests this afternoon; the infection line is already running. This is now systemic deterioration, not a clinic problem.

lines.zh: 外科已經通知，影像安排了，禁食。
lines.en: Surgeons informed, imaging arranged, nil by mouth.

post.zh: 對。「簡單的病例」就是這樣變成不簡單的。你今天看到了。
post.en: Right. That is how a 'simple case' stops being simple. You saw it happen today.

guide.en: Escalate to the mentor

lines.zh: 糞便檢驗現在才送，答案會晚一天。下午那個「有點熱熱的」就是該送的時候。
lines.en: The stool tests are only going now, so the answer arrives a day late. That 'a bit hot' this afternoon was the moment to send them.

lines.zh: 我記住了。外科已經通知，影像安排了，禁食。
lines.en: Noted. Surgeons informed, imaging arranged, nil by mouth.

post.zh: 好。錯過一次不是罪，錯過兩次才是。「簡單的病例」就是這樣變成不簡單的。
post.en: Good. Missing it once is not a sin; missing it twice is. That is how a 'simple case' stops being simple.

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 我回來了。睡了五個小時，夢到十二指腸。說吧。
lines.en: I am back. Slept five hours, dreamed about duodenums. Go.

lines.zh: 7 床吳先生，十二指腸潰瘍內視鏡止血完成。早上站起來血壓掉過一次。
lines.en: Bed 7, Mr Wu: duodenal ulcer, endoscopic haemostasis done. One episode of postural hypotension this morning.

lines.zh: 等等。你要交給他的不是「做完了」，是「接下來看什麼」。
lines.en: Wait. What you hand him is not 'it is done'. It is 'what to watch next'.

post.zh: 出血循環趨勢、血紅素趨勢、再出血警訊、止痛藥停掉。收到。林小姐外科看過了嗎？
post.en: Circulation trend, haemoglobin trend, rebleeding signs, painkillers stopped. Got it. Have the surgeons seen Ms Lin?

guide.en: Write the endoscopy report

lines.zh: 你把鏡檢所見、止血方式、檢體數量與追蹤計畫寫進報告。病理檢體兩罐，登錄號都對上了。
lines.en: You write the findings, the haemostasis method, the number of specimens and the follow-up plan. Two biopsy pots, both accession numbers matched.

lines.zh: 報告寫給三個月後的自己看。那時候你不會記得今天。
lines.en: Write the report for yourself three months from now. You will not remember today.

guide.en: Close the room: count and reprocess

lines.zh: 鏡子送洗消、器械清點、檢體送出的簽收單收好。明天第一台早上七點半。
lines.en: Scopes to reprocessing, instruments counted, specimen dispatch slips filed. First case tomorrow is at half past seven.

lines.zh: 鏡子不會自己乾淨。
lines.en: Scopes do not clean themselves.

lines.zh: 你學得很快。
lines.en: You learn fast.

guide.en: The mentor's debrief

lines.zh: 今天你學的不是潰瘍，是一句話有多危險：「血紅素還可以」。
lines.en: What you learned today was not the ulcer. It was how dangerous one sentence is: 'the haemoglobin is still acceptable'.

lines.zh: 吳先生的循環、林小姐的「有點熱熱的」、12 床的助眠藥。病人在數字之前就先說了。
lines.en: Mr Wu's circulation, Ms Lin's 'a bit hot', bed 12's sleeping pill. The patient speaks before the numbers do.

lines.zh: 師傅，你的咖啡。
lines.en: Dr Chen, your coffee.

lines.zh: 喔。冷了。明天再買一杯放著。
lines.en: Oh. Cold. I will buy another tomorrow and leave it there.

guide.en: Take the call, back to bed 7

sub.en: Bed 7 has passed another black stool

lines.zh: 阿芳。7 床剛剛又解一次黑便，量不多，心跳比傍晚快一點，血壓還好，他說不暈。
lines.en: Fang. Bed 7 has just passed another black stool, small amount. Heart rate a little faster than this evening, pressure fine, he says he is not dizzy.

lines.zh: 醫師，是不是舊的血？我真的沒有偷吃粽子。
lines.en: Doctor, is it old blood? I honestly did not sneak a dumpling.

lines.zh: 止血後排舊血很常見，但心跳變快是再出血警訊。我先看循環趨勢，床邊重評。
lines.en: Passing old blood after haemostasis is common, but a rising pulse is a rebleeding sign. Circulation trend first, then a bedside reassessment.

lines.zh: 尿量我記在這裡，半小時一次。你要打給陳主治嗎？
lines.en: Urine output is charted here, half-hourly. Are you calling Dr Chen?

lines.zh: 要。「一定是舊血」是夜班最貴的四個字。
lines.en: Yes. 'Must be old blood' are the most expensive words on a night shift.

post.zh: （電話裡）心跳趨勢、血壓、尿量，半小時後再告訴我一次。做得對。
post.en: (On the phone) Pulse trend, pressure, urine output; call me again in half an hour. You did this right.

post.zh: 醫師，孫子明天來。我會乖乖躺著。
post.en: Doctor, my grandson comes tomorrow. I will stay lying down, I promise.

sub.zh: 病人在數字之前就先說了
sub.en: The patient speaks before the numbers do
